---
name: Idea or question
about: Propose a bounded improvement or ask about intended behavior.
title: ''
---

## What would this help you do?
Describe the problem and desired outcome using a fictional example.

## Smallest useful change
Suggest a scope, alternatives, and how success could be checked.

## Constraints or question
Include relevant compatibility needs or the documentation that was unclear.
Do not include secrets, credentials, real project code, or customer/attendee data.
An issue is a proposal, not authorization to change access, merge, or publish.
